resources.string: A crash report was saved on this device. Open Settings › About to read or copy it.
A connection was closed after an internal error, and the app kept running. A report was saved; open Settings › About to read or copy it.
Retry the operation. If it fails again, inspect the relevant configuration or connection diagnostics.
Update or reparse the configuration. Check the listed protocol and field categories in configuration details.
Follow the specific cause above to check the provider configuration or download status. A failed update keeps the previous valid configuration.
Check the DNS address and selected resolver mode, then retry on the current network.
Check device time, server name and certificate trust. Verification is not disabled automatically.
Check node parameters and referenced groups. Run diagnostics for the affected node to locate the failing connection stage.
Check the rule type, referenced outbound and required rule sources. Invalid routes are not replaced with direct access.
